race.comment: SYMPHONITE (9) kept fresh for this and now in the Melissa Harrison yard. Sat on the speed in a fairly average contest to finish second over 1200m at Casterton after showing good early speed. Gets in light with the claim and expected to go close in a very thin contest. ENCHAANTED (10) got the Maiden win out of the way four back from the rails draw and comes up with that marble today. Returned from a let up and snagged back from the wide draw with a dismal sixth over 900m at Wellington. Genuine each way contender. PENCILLER (2) smart gelding resuming. Covered a stack of ground in the run with a tiring sixth over 1100m at Bathurst on May 12. Can sprint well fresh on the home track. CITY GOLD SPEED (7) comes here in peak condition and gets a better set-up in a weaker contest after finishing fifth over 1200m at Scone. Anywhere near his best can win this.
